title: Gloves of Baneful Striking

sources.title: Baneful Strike
markers: | description =  Whenever you deal damage with a weapon attack, the target receives a {{DieIcon|d4|Piercing}} -1d4 penalty to its {{SavingThrow}} against your next spell.{{see bugs}}

summary: Damaging a creature with a weapon attack applies Baneful Strike for 2 turns.

fields.Baneful Strike: Tooltip says −1d4 to the saving throw against your next spell. The pinned source reports −1d4 to all of the target’s saves for the duration.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
